canonical_distribution.container: tar stream compressed with a standard zstd frame
canonical_distribution.reason: Compressed byte offsets do not identify decompressed tar members. Without a seekable frame table or a published compressed-member index, range requests cannot start decompression at an arbitrary selected patch.

bounded_exploratory_prefix.purpose: Confirm real tar hierarchy without opening raster pixels
bounded_exploratory_prefix.finding: Members are nested as sensor/source-scene-or-tile/patch/file, adding a parent level absent from the Phase 4B logical directory hints.

archive_member_templates.manifest_policy: Do not alter split_manifest.json. The Phase 4D materializer must derive and validate the parent directory while treating manifest patch_id and s1_name as the identity authority.

alternative_distributions_and_tools.name: TorchGeo Hugging Face BigEarthNet V2 mirror
alternative_distributions_and_tools.finding: It preserves the BigEarthNet v2 filenames and metadata but re-compresses each sensor archive as two split tar.gz parts totaling about 119 GB. It offers no per-patch objects, and extracted TIFF equality was not independently proven in this audit.

alternative_distributions_and_tools.name: rico-hdl
alternative_distributions_and_tools.finding: This dataset-maintainer tool converts extracted named TIFF arrays into band-keyed Safetensors inside LMDB and documents identical array values. It is useful after canonical extraction, but it is not a distribution and does not preserve the native GeoTIFF container/georeferencing audit surface.

alternative_distributions_and_tools.name: BigEarthNet.txt infrastructure
alternative_distributions_and_tools.finding: The repository publishes text metadata and a loader that expects a separately supplied image LMDB; it does not publish per-patch canonical GeoTIFF assets.

alternative_distributions_and_tools.name: hackelle/BigEarthNetV2-LMDB
alternative_distributions_and_tools.finding: Its own card labels the 155 GB LMDB an unofficial community pre-conversion. It is larger than the canonical compressed pair, is not selective, and cannot supply native TIFF headers.

recommended_acquisition_route.route: Download one canonical Zenodo archive at a time, verify its publisher MD5, sequentially decompress it once, and allowlist-extract only members belonging to the frozen 18,001-pair manifest. Seal test members from inspection and evaluation.
recommended_acquisition_route.why: This is the only audited route that retains canonical GeoTIFF pixels, headers, patch identity, band semantics, and CDLA-Permissive-1.0 provenance.
recommended_acquisition_route.storage_plan: Processing one sensor at a time requires roughly the larger 58.91 GiB archive plus the Phase 4B estimated 3.591 GiB selected output and working margin, rather than retaining both 109.61 GiB archives simultaneously.
integrity_gates: Derive nested member paths from manifest s1_name and patch_id; never enumerate into tensor order.
Reject missing, duplicate, unexpected, or path-traversal members.
Verify exactly two S1 and twelve S2 band files per selected pair.
Keep split_manifest.json byte-identical and record extracted-file hashes in a separate sidecar.
